Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V2-L-likemyfatherbeforeme-2020-07-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V2-L-likemyfatherbeforeme-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V2-L-likemyfatherbeforeme-2020-07-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V2-L-likemyfatherbeforeme-2020-07-12.gif]], 12 July 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[Like My Father Before Me]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-likemyfatherbeforeme022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/likemyfatherbeforeme.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Light/large/likemyfatherbeforeme.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
